split_policy.primary_axis: runtime fixture role before fixture path convenience, diagnostic sidecar, conformance manifest row, runtime probe pointer, generated report pointer, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: runtime positives are hand-authored tests/native/runtime fixtures with fixture_kind=positive, canonical_behavior_source=true, and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.strict_error_rule: dispatch misses and unresolved runtime-dispatch symbols are strict-error evidence; they are not positive runtime support
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, runtime-backed conformance manifests, runtime probe pointers, report pointers, generated artifacts, and metadata field names are provenance unless tied to a runtime fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, gate, retired route, generated-only, evidence-log, and migration-only runtime rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no parser, sema, lowering, IR, or e2e behavior contracts
